name: g46_switch_sitrus_voluntary
purpose: A voluntary switch (no drag) of Kingambit in slot 1 for the Decidueye holding Sitrus Berry in reserve position 3, while the Decidueye holding Sitrus Berry of the other side stands in slot 2: the switch's BeforeSwitchOut Update and the entry's Update are a real tie of two Sitrus holders. Control for the step G46 drag fix: a switch that is not a drag queues its entry (insertChoice refreshes the entrant's speed).
